system.description: Passive DNS system to query; e.g., 'dnsdb' or 'circl'.

api_key.description: API key for Farsight DNSDB. Required for dnsdb system.

server_url.description: Base URL of the Passive DNS API server, optionally with URI prefix.

circl_auth.description: Authentication credentials for CIRCL passive DNS (format: user:pass).

circl_server.description: URL of the CIRCL passive DNS server.
